description: Fail-closed mapping from changed workspace paths to the smallest sufficient test and governance scope.

rules.note: BLOCK-78 摘要卡片项目化：远程资源实时快照——node-agent sys_resource verb（ensureAgent 哈希自动部署）/ gateway sysResource 方法 / harness 资源路由 projectId 路由（additive，无参/local 既有调用零改动）/ 归一化与 TTL 缓存 helper / 前端 hook projectId 参数与卡片 source 驱动。零网络测试锁归一化三态阈值 + TTL fresh/stale/unreachable + agent 脚本 bash 语法与本机执行；实机 dell 读数对账与断连三态归 BLOCK-78 P3 验收。
Git backend changes run lifecycle/repository tests; the now-green P4R source/replay invariant is selected by Result Studio production paths rather than every low-level adapter edit.
BLOCK-16/20 working tree review IPC（diff 解析 / hunk accept-reject / revert / file-content）。UI-180 实机验收发现 reject 反向 patch 因 phantom 空 ctx 行被 git apply 拒绝，修复后此映射保证回归不被漏测。

P4R source projection, controlled replay, background materialization and Code tests are owned by P4R; the explicit invariant gates remain listed so a route regression cannot be hidden by the default bundle.

SDC1-A keeps project-local import, bounded structural profiling, fail-closed readiness, the existing Agent handoff, and its development Electron observer under one focused regression bundle; it does not qualify SDC-2+ or P7. Frontend tests are selected through frontendRelated and run by Vitest.

Conversation-bound ToolJob identity covers migration, creation, approval continuation, plugin execution/retry, ScientificTask/workflow binding, Result Studio derived execution, all job-history projections, and frontend compatibility mapping. Frontend tests are selected through frontendRelated and run by Vitest.

Current-conversation result discovery and title-bar switching must preserve exact conversation identity, deep-link scope, and the existing Result Studio selection contract. Frontend tests are selected through frontendRelated and run by Vitest. UI-359: titlebar 右区路由上下文裁剪与面板开合快捷键同归本规则。

UX1H keeps the real conversation-run timeout shape, successful run_tool presentation, deterministic development Electron airway observation, and its non-qualifying evidence under one focused gate. g0-sdc1 脚本的脚本分类唯一归属 script-g0-maintained（一脚本一分类），其回归覆盖经 sdc1-data-to-first-result 规则选择。
Agent result and evidence redaction changes must exercise both generic diagnostic scrubbing and Agent tool-result projections.
BLOCK-59 窗口系统：窗口管理器核心（状态机/注册表/路由白名单/geometry）+ Electron 适配器 IPC 面。改动即跑核心单测（含适配器/preload/main.js 静态契约锁）。
BLOCK-48 电脑控制：Swift sidecar 源码与协议契约测试。改动即跑契约测试（前置构建：bash scripts/build-computer-use-sidecar.sh）。

The P4R capture, live journey and renderer producers also match script-result-current, which classifies them. This rule adds their real harness tests so evidence drift cannot hide behind qualification-only checks.

The P5 producer and its source-bound evidence must select the complete focused scientific-editing contract bundle. The producer already has one script classification through script-result-current; this rule adds its direct verifier and every P5 Truth, validator, cohort, replay and scientific-diff regression.

The P6 UI-110 producer and source-bound evidence select their direct Electron adapter, context transport, candidate-cohort reopen, artifact-family hydration, and redaction regressions without starting the long trace.

The non-qualifying P6-1a synthetic service fixture and its optional checkpoint select source binding, runtime-lease, exact-cohort, lifecycle, background-process and public redaction regressions; this rule does not represent full P6 product acceptance.

Exact P6 runtime-lease and resource-accounting paths add their direct lifecycle, persistence and aggregation regressions. Result Studio-named files may also match the shared Result Studio bundle; the standalone sampler must never rely on that broad pattern.
The bounded real stop/failure/drift/SIGKILL restart prototype selects its direct fail-closed verdict and opt-in runtime regression without running the expensive scenarios by default.
The development Electron 100k-row, media, long-report and multi-Revision pressure producer, driver and non-closeout checkpoint select their direct source-binding, budget and renderer regression.
The development Electron interruption/relaunch prototype and hardened driver select their direct explanation, recovery-request, process-boundary and sanitizer regression.
The bounded real resource queue, stale adoption, controlled transport and GC/cold-readback scenarios select their direct evaluator without starting the opt-in live run.

Every source byte eligible for the canonical P6 binding selects the fast recomputing verifier. The bounded broad prefixes are intentional: a future source-map addition inside the same runtime surfaces must fail closed until evidence is refreshed, while the expensive live matrix remains opt-in.

The canonical P6 producer and stored source-bound evidence select the direct recomputing verifier plus every component, durability, resource and private-artifact route regression. The default gate verifies stored observations; only the explicit update command runs the long real matrix.

The P7 source-bound producer is the only current Result Studio qualification owner. Default tests verify its independently resolvable fact-bundle contract and packaged CDP adapter; the explicit update gate alone builds and drives the real arm64 package with two configured Provider classes.

Evidence trees with no Node test reader. Their owning npm gate regenerates and verifies them, so changing the stored evidence selects no test. Listed explicitly so a new acceptance/<tree> stays unmapped and fails closed until its verification owner is declared.
Phase 3 IDE MCP git tools (git-diff / git-log / git-show / git-blame) are exercised by the dedicated test files. The new test files are also auto-selected by test-infrastructure through test/**.
BLOCK 实机 CDP 驱动与探针（acceptance/block-N 证据采集），一次性证据脚本按 development-smoke 分类。 BLOCK-57 实机 SSH 全链驱动（aliyun 真实节点 + in-app 分派）同分类。
BLOCK-63 P3 编排注册：Windows sidecar 托管（computer-use-host 平台门/双平台定位）+ computer_* 工具 handler 确认门真链。改动即跑 host 契约测试（前置：sidecar 已构建）。
BLOCK-66 运行时解耦：R 硬门摘除（biof3-server 无 R 可用）。改动即跑 backend-health 语义拆分测试。
BLOCK-63 Windows 电脑控制：C#/FlaUI sidecar 源码与协议契约测试。改动即跑契约测试（前置构建：powershell sidecars/computer-use-windows/build.ps1）。 live 脚本 scripts/block63-*.cjs 归 script-block-live-drivers 分类。
BLOCK-71 开发基础设施沉淀：会话状态/卫生检查/收口聚合/dev-verify 底座（canonical 家在 gewu-dev-infra skill 内）。工具自身改动跑 test/dev-verify.test.mjs + 冒烟（npm run state / hygiene:check / skills:check）。
BLOCK-75 OS 级验收：原生另存为对话框 flow（EnumWindows 定位 + sidecar hwnd 直投）+ P0 抓真修的 diagnostic:export 链（相对 require 漂移）。改动即跑 ipc 相对 require 门禁 + redaction 契约。
BLOCK-76 P1 SSH 直跑执行链：ssh-direct-runner（gateway 写编排面/exec_bg/.exit 终态/进程组取消）+ tools-executor ssh 分支 + mcp registry 收编。改动即跑 runner 零网络契约测试。
BLOCK-77 驻留任务：意图卡创建/列举/读取工具与定义契约。改动即跑 block77 契约测试。
BLOCK-79 按供应商的 token 输出速率：ai_usage provider 归因列（additive）+ model-gateway attempt 级注入 + summarizeProviderUsage 成对聚合（端到端平均输出速率口径·embedding 排除·zero-usage 不可算）+ usage-mine providers 分组段 + 设置页供应商速率表。
BLOCK-81 思考档位：映射内核 + 协议转换搬运 + 网关注入与去参重试（P1）。
dev 栈/实机验收编排脚本（BLOCK-77 沉淀的 restart-dev-stack.sh + 窗口尺寸辅助）。非产品代码，改动只需跑脚本冒烟（--check/语法），故 tests 挂 dev-verify 契约测试。
UI-345 composer 思考档位验收脚本（BLOCK-81 P2/P3）：开启渠道能力位→控件出现→切档→发送→查任务参数档位→复原；P3 增加真渠道标准/高对比（UI 实发体 vs 上游 requestBody 双向对账）与渠道参数接受度矩阵。
BLOCK-82 思考渠道兼容：sensenova 系 reasoning 字段归一（reasoning_content 优先/reasoning 兜底，deepseek.js 流式+非流式信封、io-transcript.js 记录面）+ 真渠道实机验收脚本。
dev-verify 探针 flow 证据目录（app-health 等环境健康检查产物，非工作包验收证据链）。
BLOCK-79 token 速率可观测性实机证据目录（收口时漏登记 impact-map，test-affected 存量 unknown；本包顺手清债）。
UI-341 欢迎页收敛系列实机证据目录（BLOCK-80 时期收口时漏登记 impact-map，test-affected 存量 unknown；本包顺手清债）。
BLOCK-83 通用底座化与生信插件化剥离：task-confirmation-hooks 注册表（D3 钩子化）/ result-studio 契约改名（D1）/ SDK 脚本模板放宽（D2）/ canonical-json 上提 + P1 出口实机验收脚本。

BLOCK-84 领域包产品级一键装/卸：记录制 pack-registry（installed.json）+ boot 接线（插件源追加 / 领域工具注册）+ Electron IPC（pack:* 5 handlers）+ 商店「领域包」分区 + 一键装/卸实机验收（隔离探针 + CDP UI 双态）。同时覆盖 dev 渲染器 origin 白名单（trusted origins 双变体）与本地请求边界契约。
BLOCK-70 手机远程同步：mobile-gateway 独立 app 实例（配对 token/会话吊销/鉴权限速审计）+ mobile-admin 管理 REST + 设置区「手机远程」（UI-319）+ 移动只读页。改 gateway/admin/设置面板任一文件即跑本套件。
